units.title: Introduction to Gravure Printing Process
topics: 1.1. Introduction to Gravure printing process and application areas, Features of Gravure Printing Process
1.2. Image carrier and Press Sections of Gravure printing process.

1.6. Comparison with other Printing process.

units.title: Gravure Cylinder Preparation
topics: 2.1. Characteristics and construction of gravure printing cylinder.
2.2. Study of required properties of surface metals such as copper, nickel used in gravure printing cylinder making.
2.3. Understand terminologies like cell wall, depth-to- opening ratio, cell angle, engraving resolution, calculation of total engraving time.
2.4. Stages involved in reclaiming gravure printing cylinder.
2.5. Cylinder Base- sleeve, integral shaft, Balancing methods
2.6. Study of different types and calculation of volume formula of engraved cell geometries such as inverted pyramidal, quadrangular, channeled, hexagonal.
2.7. Cylinder correction methods-Plus and minus correction.
2.8. Different material used in cylinder making with their property and its purpose.
2.9. Automation and Environmental aspects.

units.title: Gravure Cylinder Engraving
